title: Headlamp Desktop app build manifest
description: Configures product metadata, packaged plugins and resources, and runtime command policy for a Headlamp Desktop build.

$schema.description: JSON Schema used by editors to validate this manifest.

$comment.description: A note for people maintaining this manifest.

proxy-urls.description: HTTP(S) URL patterns the packaged backend may proxy. Only * wildcards are supported.

plugins.description: Plugins downloaded and bundled into the desktop package.

commandSets.description: Reusable named command grant arrays. A runCommands policy composes one or more with commandSets instead of repeating commands.

product.description: Product identity applied to Electron Builder and generated frontend metadata.

resources.description: Files and directories appended to Electron Builder's extraResources.

runCommands.description: Command policies for Headlamp Desktop plugins. Each entry selects an app runtime mode, a plugin installation location, one or more exact plugin identities, and the commands those plugins may request. Production policies for plugin-manager-installed user plugins should pin Artifact Hub UUIDs; development-mode, development-location, and shipped policies should omit them. See ../docs/development/plugins/command-capabilities.md or https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/development/plugins/command-capabilities/#product-manifest-policy.

targets.description: Electron Builder package targets selected per platform.

platforms.description: Electron Builder metadata overrides selected per platform.

verify.description: Packaged resources whose SHA-256 digests must be verified after packaging.

legalDocuments.description: Legal documents exposed by the packaged desktop application.

pluginCommandPolicy.description: Commands granted to exact plugin identities for one Headlamp runtime mode and one plugin installation location.

environment.description: Headlamp app mode in which this policy applies. This selects the running app, not where the plugin is installed.

oneOf.description: Apply when Headlamp Desktop is running in development mode.
Apply in a packaged production build of Headlamp Desktop.

pluginLocation.description: Plugin installation location that must contain the authorized bundle. This selects the plugin files, not the Headlamp app mode.

oneOf.description: The operator-controlled development plugin inventory exposed under plugins/. This can contain legacy catalog installations even in production builds. Plugins here have no plugin-manager provenance receipt; policy authors trust users with write access to this inventory. See ../docs/development/plugins/command-capabilities.md or https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/development/plugins/command-capabilities/#security-considerations.
The user-installed plugin inventory exposed under user-plugins/.
The read-only plugin inventory bundled with the desktop application and exposed under static-plugins/.

plugins.description: Exact bundle directory and package.json identities sharing these grants. For production policies in the user location, add artifactHubPackage, artifactHubPackageId, and artifactHubRepositoryId. Omit Artifact Hub identity from development-mode, development-location, and shipped policies because those bundles have no plugin-manager installation receipt. See ../docs/development/plugins/command-capabilities.md or https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/development/plugins/command-capabilities/#product-manifest-policy.

pluginExecutables.description: Tools supplied by these plugin bundles at the derived path bin/<tool> instead of resolved on the sanitized system PATH.

commands.description: Command identifiers and argument sequences these plugins may request. Every request is matched against these entries in Electron before a process starts.

commandSets.description: Names of reusable grant arrays in top-level commandSets, combined in order. Use this instead of commands when policies share grants.

pluginExecutable.description: A plugin-owned native executable at the derived path bin/<tool>, confined to the verified bundle and integrity-checked before production execution.

tool.description: Command identifier whose grants use this plugin-owned executable.

bundleName.description: Bundle directory name reported by plugin discovery.

packageName.description: Exact package name expected in the bundle's package.json.

artifactHubPackage.description: Artifact Hub repository and package names in <repository>/<package> form, for example headlamp-plugins/headlamp_minikube. Required for production policies in the plugin-manager-installed user location. Omit from development and shipped locations, which have no installation receipt. See ../docs/development/plugins/command-capabilities.md or https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/development/plugins/command-capabilities/#product-manifest-policy.

artifactHubPackageId.description: Immutable package UUID pin from the package_id field returned by https://artifacthub.io/api/v1/packages/headlamp/<repository>/<package>. Recommended with artifactHubRepositoryId for production policies in the plugin-manager-installed user location; omit from development-mode, development-location, and shipped policies. See ../docs/development/plugins/command-capabilities.md or https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/development/plugins/command-capabilities/#product-manifest-policy.

artifactHubRepositoryId.description: Immutable repository UUID pin from the repository.repository_id field returned by https://artifacthub.io/api/v1/packages/headlamp/<repository>/<package>. Recommended with artifactHubPackageId for production policies in the plugin-manager-installed user location; omit from development-mode, development-location, and shipped policies. See ../docs/development/plugins/command-capabilities.md or https://headlamp.dev/docs/latest/development/plugins/command-capabilities/#product-manifest-policy.

tool.description: Command identifier matched exactly against a plugin request. Most values name an executable, such as minikube or az. The special scriptjs value asks Headlamp to run an authorized plugin JavaScript file with Electron. Do not include a filesystem path.

args.description: Ordered arguments matched after tool. They are an exact sequence unless allowTrailingArgs is true, in which case they are the required prefix.

allowTrailingArgs.description: When false or omitted, the request must have exactly args. When true, the request may append more arguments after that required prefix.
